title: Project configuration — software-analysis capability
description: Formal shape of the project's `.pkit/capabilities/software-analysis/project/config.yaml`: the settings of the capability a project chooses. One today, `numbering.freed-by` (DEC-001 point 3): the commits whose removed files' numbers are free again. Whether each names one commit here, on the default branch's history, the stamp (`pkit analysis new`) and the number check (`pkit analysis check-numbers`) judge, since each reads git; not this schema. Document-shaped schema: the file IS the resource (no top-level id collection). Companion per COR-018.

binds_to.description: Repo-relative globs matching the adopter-data files this schema validates (COR-023 fallback binding). Present on the capability-side carrier; absent from a project's file.

numbering.description: How use cases and journeys are numbered (DEC-001 point 3).

freed-by.description: The commits whose removed files' numbers are free again: a number the default branch's history gave a file one of them deleted — not renamed — is no longer counted. Nothing else frees a number: a file any other commit removed still holds its number, and so does a file the working tree or the default branch holds.

commit-name.description: A commit, by its full hexadecimal id or an abbreviation of it that names it alone, in lower case: 4 digits at least. Quoted in YAML, as digits alone read as a number.
